# Function reference

<!-- Generated by tools/Update-FunctionDocs.ps1 - do not edit by hand. -->

96 functions. In your shell, `pf` shows this list and `Get-Help <Name> -Full` shows full help and examples.

`(Win)` = alias only exists on Windows, so it doesn't hide the real tool on macOS/Linux. **J** = from [jonlabelle/pwsh-profile](https://github.com/jonlabelle/pwsh-profile).

**Categories:** [ActiveDirectory](#activedirectory) (8) | [ModuleManagement](#modulemanagement) (3) | [Navigation](#navigation) (2) | [Network](#network) (26) | [Profile](#profile) (6) | [Security](#security) (4) | [System](#system) (22) | [Utilities](#utilities) (25)

## ActiveDirectory

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Copy-ADGroupMembership` | `copygroups` | Copies group memberships from one AD user to another ("make them like Bob"). | `Copy-ADGroupMembership -From bsmith -To jdoe -WhatIf` |  |
| `Find-ADGroupQuick` | `seg` | Fuzzy AD group search across name, account name and description. | `seg vpn` |  |
| `Find-ADUserQuick` | `seu` | Fuzzy AD user search across name, display name, username, email and description. | `seu smith` |  |
| `Get-LockedUsers` | `locked` | Lists every locked-out AD account with its last bad password time. | `locked` |  |
| `Get-UserStatus` | `ustat` | One-glance AD account health: enabled, locked, password expiry, last logon. | `ustat jsmith` |  |
| `Invoke-GroupPolicyUpdate` |  | Forces an immediate Group Policy update on Windows systems. | `Invoke-GroupPolicyUpdate` | J |
| `Test-ADCredential` |  | Test the username and password of Active Directory credentials. | `$cred = Get-Credential` | J |
| `Test-ADUserLocked` |  | Test if an Active Directory user account is locked out. | `Test-ADUserLocked -UserName 'jdoe'` | J |

## Network

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Clear-DnsCache` | `flushdns` | Flushes the DNS resolver cache on Windows, macOS or Linux. | `flushdns` |  |
| `Convert-MacAddress` | `mac` | Converts a MAC address between formats (colon, dash, Cisco dot, plain). | `mac 00-1A-2B-3C-4D-5E` |  |
| `ConvertTo-CidrNotation` |  | Converts between subnet mask, CIDR prefix length, and wildcard mask formats. | `ConvertTo-CidrNotation -SubnetMask '255.255.255.0'` | J |
| `Get-CertificateExpiration` | `certexp` | Connects to a TLS endpoint and reports when its certificate expires. | `certexp github.com` |  |
| `Get-DnsRecord` |  | Retrieves DNS records for a specified domain name. | `Get-DnsRecord -Name 'bing.com'` | J |
| `Get-IPAddress` |  | Retrieves local network interface IP addresses and the public external IP address. | `Get-IPAddress` | J |
| `Get-IPSubnet` |  | Calculate IP subnet information including network address, broadcast address, and subnet mask. | `Get-IPSubnet -CIDR '192.168.0.0/24'` | J |
| `Get-MyIP` | `myip` | Shows your local IPv4 address(es) and your public IP. | `myip` |  |
| `Get-NetworkMetric` |  |  |  | J |
| `Get-NetworkProcess` |  | Shows local network ports and the processes using them. | `Get-NetworkProcess -Port 5432` | J |
| `Get-NetworkRoute` |  | Displays the local routing table as structured PowerShell objects. | `Get-NetworkRoute` | J |
| `Get-PublicDnsServer` |  | Returns a curated list of well-known public DNS servers. | `Get-PublicDnsServer` | J |
| `Get-ReverseDns` |  | Performs reverse DNS (PTR) lookups for IP addresses. | `Get-ReverseDns -IPAddress '8.8.8.8'` | J |
| `Get-Whois` |  | Performs WHOIS lookups for domain names and IP addresses. | `Get-Whois -Domain 'bing.com'` | J |
| `Invoke-NetworkDiagnostics` | `netdiag` | Performs comprehensive network diagnostics with visual output | `Invoke-NetworkDiagnostics -HostName 'bing.com'` | J |
| `Invoke-Ping` |  | Sends ICMP echo requests (ping) to test network connectivity. | `Invoke-Ping -ComputerName 'bing.com'` | J |
| `Resolve-GeoIP` |  | Resolves IP addresses to geographic location information. | `Resolve-GeoIP` | J |
| `Send-TcpRequest` |  | Send a TCP request to a remote computer and return the response. Supports both interactive and scripted modes with optional SSL encryption. | `Send-TcpRequest -ComputerName "bing.com" -Port 443 -Test` | J |
| `Show-NetworkLatencyGraph` |  | Displays ASCII graph visualizations of network latency data | `$latencies = @(15, 14, 16, 22, 15, 14, 13, 16)` | J |
| `Test-Bandwidth` |  | Tests network bandwidth with download speed and latency measurements. | `Test-Bandwidth` | J |
| `Test-DnsNameResolution` |  | Tests if a DNS name can be resolved. | `Test-DnsNameResolution -Name 'bing.com'` | J |
| `Test-DnsPropagation` |  | Checks DNS propagation across multiple public DNS servers. | `Test-DnsPropagation bing.com -IncludeLocal \| Format-Table -AutoSize` | J |
| `Test-HttpResponse` |  | Tests HTTP/HTTPS endpoints and returns response details. | `Test-HttpResponse -Uri 'https://jonlabelle.com'` | J |
| `Test-Port` | `tp` | Fast TCP port check for one or more hosts and ports. | `Test-Port dc01 389,636,3268` |  |
| `Test-TlsProtocol` |  | Tests TLS protocol support and security evidence for a remote TCP service. | `Test-TlsProtocol -ComputerName 'www.example.com' -Protocol Tls12,Tls13` | J |
| `Trace-Route` |  | Performs a cross-platform traceroute to a destination host. | `Trace-Route -ComputerName 'bing.com'` | J |

## Profile

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Edit-Profile` | `ep` | Opens the profile repo in your editor (VS Code if installed), or one function's file. | `ep                 # whole repo` |  |
| `Invoke-ProfileReload` | `reload` | Reloads the profile in the current session - picks up new and edited function files. | `reload` |  |
| `Measure-ProfileLoad` |  | Measures how many milliseconds this profile adds to shell startup. | `Measure-ProfileLoad` |  |
| `New-ProfileFunction` | `newfn` | Creates a new function file from a template, registers it, and opens it for editing. | `New-ProfileFunction Get-PrinterQueue -Category System -Alias pq` |  |
| `Show-ProfileFunction` | `pf` | Lists every profile function with its aliases, category and one-line description. | `pf` |  |
| `Update-Profile` |  | Pulls the latest profile from GitHub and reloads it. | `Update-Profile` |  |

## Security

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ConvertFrom-JwtToken` | `decode-jwt` | Decodes a JWT (JSON Web Token) and returns its header and payload. | `$token = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6IkpvaG4gRG9lIiwiaWF0IjoxNTE2MjM5MDIyfQ.SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c"` | J |
| `Get-CertificateInfo` |  | Gets detailed SSL/TLS certificate information from remote hosts or certificate files. | `Get-CertificateInfo -ComputerName 'jonlabelle.com'` | J |
| `Protect-PathWithPassword` | `encrypt` | Encrypts files or folders with AES-256 encryption using a password. | `Protect-PathWithPassword -Path "C:\Documents\secret.txt"` | J |
| `Unprotect-PathWithPassword` | `decrypt` | Decrypts files that were encrypted with Protect-PathWithPassword. | `Unprotect-PathWithPassword -Path "C:\Documents\secret.txt.enc"` | J |

## System

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enter-NewDirectory` | `mkcd` | Creates a folder (and any parents) and moves into it. | `mkcd C:\temp\logs\today` |  |

| `Get-FolderSize` | `du` | Size of each subfolder, biggest first - find what is filling a disk. | `du C:\Users -Top 10` |  |
| `Get-Hash` | `hash` | File hash in one line, optionally checked against the hash from a vendor's download page. | `hash .\installer.msi` |  |
| `Get-PathPermission` |  | Shows file and directory permission details for one or more paths. | `Get-PathPermission -Path ~/.ssh, ~/.config` | J |
| `Get-RecentErrors` | `errs` | Latest Critical/Error events from the System and Application logs (Windows). | `errs` |  |
| `Get-SystemInfo` |  | Gets system information from local or remote computers. | `Get-SystemInfo -NoEmptyProps -NoPII` | J |
| `Get-TlsSecurityProtocol` |  | Gets the current TLS security protocol configuration for the PowerShell session. | `Get-TlsSecurityProtocol` | J |
| `Get-TopProcess` | `topp` | Top processes by memory or CPU time. | `topp` |  |
| `Invoke-ElevatedCommand` |  | Runs a script block with elevated privileges and passes pipeline input. | `Invoke-ElevatedCommand { Get-Service \| Where-Object Status -eq 'Running' }` | J |
| `New-File` | `touch` | Creates an empty file, or updates its timestamp if it exists (like 'touch'). | `touch notes.txt` |  |
| `Set-PathPermission` |  | Sets filesystem permissions for files and directories. | `Set-PathPermission -Path ~/.ssh/config -OwnerPermission Read, Write -GroupPermission None -OtherPermission None` | J |
| `Set-TlsSecurityProtocol` |  | Configures TLS security protocol settings for secure network connections. | `Set-TlsSecurityProtocol` | J |
| `Show-SystemResourceMonitor` |  | Displays a visual monitor for CPU, memory, disk, and network activity. | `Show-SystemResourceMonitor` | J |
| `Show-Uptime` | `uptime` | Last boot time and uptime, like the Linux 'uptime' command. Works on remote Windows hosts too. | `uptime` |  |
| `Start-Elevated` | `admin` | Opens an elevated (Administrator) shell, optionally running a command in it. | `admin` |  |
| `Start-KeepAlive` | `ska` | Prevents the system and display from sleeping. | `Start-KeepAlive` | J |
| `Test-Admin` | `Test-Root` `Test-Sudo` | Determines if the current PowerShell session is running with elevated privileges. | `Test-Admin` | J |
| `Test-PendingReboot` |  | Tests various registry values to see if the local computer is pending a reboot. | `Test-PendingReboot` | J |
| `Unblock-Downloads` | `ubd` | Removes the "downloaded from the internet" block from files in your Downloads folder (Windows). | `ubd` |  |

## Utilities

| Function | Alias | What it does | Example | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Convert-LineEnding` |  | Converts line endings between LF (Unix) and CRLF (Windows) with optional file encoding conversion. | `Convert-LineEnding -Path 'script.ps1' -LineEnding 'LF'` | J |
| `ConvertFrom-Base64` | `unb64` | Decodes Base64 to text (UTF-8), or to a file with -OutFile. | `unb64 aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=` |  |
| `ConvertTo-Base64` | `b64` | Encodes text (UTF-8) or a file to Base64. | `b64 'hello world'` |  |
| `ConvertTo-TimeZone` |  | Converts date/time values from one time zone to one or more other time zones. | `ConvertTo-TimeZone '2026-07-04 12:00' -FromTimeZone Eastern -ToTimeZone India` | J |
| `Copy-Directory` |  | Copies a directory with optional recursion, directory and file exclusions, and parallel processing. | `Copy-Directory -Source '.\MyProject' -Destination 'C:\Backup\MyProject' -ExcludeDirectories '.git', 'node_modules' -ExcludeFiles '*.log', '.DS_Store' -Recurse` | J |
| `Extract-Archive` | `extract` | Extracts archive files in a directory to folders named after each archive, with optional nested extraction. | `Extract-Archive` | J |
| `Format-Byte` |  | Formats byte or bit quantities into human-friendly unit conversions. | `Format-Byte -Value 1048576` | J |
| `Get-ClipboardList` | `cliplist` | Turns a pasted list (from Excel, email, a ticket...) into a clean array. | `cliplist \| Test-Port -Port 3389` |  |
| `Get-CommandAlias` |  | Lists all aliases for the specified PowerShell command. | `Get-CommandAlias -Name Get-ChildItem` | J |
| `Get-DadJoke` | `joke` | A random dad joke from icanhazdadjoke.com. Add 'joke' to local.ps1 for one on every new shell. | `joke` |  |
| `Get-EncodingFromName` |  | Resolves a profile encoding name to a .NET encoding instance. | `Get-EncodingFromName -EncodingName 'UTF8'` | J |
| `Get-FileEncoding` |  | Detects text file encoding using BOM and content sampling. | `Get-FileEncoding -FilePath './notes.txt'` | J |
| `Get-StringHash` |  | Computes the hash value for arbitrary string input using a specified hash algorithm. | `Get-StringHash -InputObject 'Hello, World!'` | J |
| `Get-Weather` | `weather` | Weather in the terminal from wttr.in. | `weather` |  |
| `New-Password` | `genpass` | Generates strong random passwords locally (no website involved) and can copy one to the clipboard. | `genpass` |  |
| `New-SymbolicLink` |  | Creates a symbolic link to a file or directory. | `New-SymbolicLink -Path '~/link-to-docs' -Target '~/Documents'` | J |
| `Remove-OldFile` |  | Removes files older than a specified time period with optional recursion. | `Remove-OldFile -OlderThan 30` | J |
| `Remove-SymbolicLink` |  | Removes a symbolic link without deleting the target. | `Remove-SymbolicLink -Path '~/link-to-docs'` | J |
| `Replace-StringInFile` | `sarep` | Finds and replaces text in files. | `Replace-StringInFile -Path config.txt -OldString 'localhost' -NewString '192.168.1.100'` | J |
| `Search-DelimitedFile` |  | Searches rows in character-delimited files using one or more column criteria. | `Search-DelimitedFile -Path './users.csv' -Criteria @{ Status = '^Active$'; City = '^Boston$' }` | J |
| `Search-FileContent` | `search` | Searches file contents with advanced features beyond grep. | `Search-FileContent -Pattern 'function' -Path ./Functions -Recurse` | J |
| `Set-FileEncoding` |  | Converts one or more text files to a specified encoding. | `Set-FileEncoding -Path './notes.txt' -Encoding UTF8BOM` | J |
| `Set-WindowTitle` | `title` | Sets the console window/tab title (the prompt resets it when you change folders). | `title PROD - be careful` |  |
| `Show-FileStorageMetrics` |  | Calculates file storage metrics and displays a graphical summary. | `Show-FileStorageMetrics` | J |
| `Sync-Directory` |  | Synchronizes directories using native platform tools (rsync on macOS/Linux, robocopy on Windows). | `Sync-Directory -Source '.\MyProject' -Destination 'D:\Backup\MyProject'` | J |
